periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering ventrally toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elliptical/teardrop morphology with a vertical bias, approximately 1.5:1 height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the patch extends significantly below the geometric center of the ocular region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape with a relatively straight posterior margin across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering approximately 30% of the visible torso length along the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, approximately 1.5 times the width of a single pinna region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex curvature forming a regular semicircular arc at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant beige-to-brown chromic shift in the posterior dorsal fur compared to the bright white cranial fur.
